description.en: TruthInsightBench evaluates open-ended scientific discovery agents on 40 blind tasks across 10 scientific domains. Each task presents a neutral research objective with frozen data while source conclusions are withheld. A fixed LLM-based judge scores agents' claims along six dimensions with 29 artifact-grounded items, and automated aggregation produces overall scores. Data and scoring code are publicly available.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing benchmark evaluation often rewards reproducing a hidden study rather than genuine discovery. TruthInsightBench measures whether agents can derive trustworthy scientific claims without seeing expected outcomes, filling a gap in evaluating AI-scientist systems for authentic discovery and making the bottleneck of scientific judgment measurable.
